title: Face unlock andhera mein kaise kaam karta hai?
hooks: Andhera bilkul ghup... phir bhi phone aapka chehra kaise pehchan leta hai?
Face unlock andhere mein jaadu lagta hai, par iska raaz infrared dots mein hai.
Kya aapka phone andhere mein aapko pehchanta hai? Dekhiye ye kaise hota hai.
hook_why: It starts with a relatable problem (pitch black darkness) and immediately poses the curiosity question with a high-stakes visual.
metaphor: An invisible 3D digital mask made of 30,000 light points.
mechanism: Flood Illuminator coats the face in infrared light
Dot Projector throws 30,000+ invisible IR dots
Infrared Camera captures the dot pattern
Processor compares the 3D map with stored biometric data
Secure Enclave grants access if the 3D structure matches

caption:
Andhere mein bhi Face ID kaise kaam karta hai? 🌙✨

Ye koi jaadu nahi, balki 30,000 invisible dots ka kamaal hai jo aapke chehre ka 3D map banate hain. Isliye ye itna secure hai!

Aapka phone andhere mein kitni der mein unlock hota hai? 👇

claims.claim: Face ID uses a Dot Projector to throw 30,000+ dots.
claims.basis: Common technical specification for Apple's Face ID hardware.

claims.claim: Infrared sensors allow face unlock to work in total darkness.
claims.basis: Source: timesnowhindi.com states infrared sensors can recognize faces even in the dark.

claims.claim: Face unlock creates a 3D digital map of the face.
claims.basis: Source: timesnowhindi.com and makeuseof.com explain the use of depth sensors and 3D mapping.

steps_learned: Flood Illuminator fills the face with infrared light.
Dot Projector throws over 30,000 invisible dots on the face.
The dots create a digital mask to measure facial depth.
Infrared camera scans this 3D pattern and sends it to the processor.
Processor matches the scan with stored data to unlock.
missing_steps: The initial setup process where the phone records facial features (eyes, nose, structure) to create the baseline profile.
The distinction that not all phones use this hardware; some rely only on software/front camera, which is why some phones struggle in the dark.
The role of AI in analyzing the facial features during the initial scan.
unsourced: The specific number '30,000' dots is a common claim for Apple's Face ID but is not mentioned in the provided sources.
The claim that 'photo 3D nahi hoti' is implied by the source but not explicitly stated as the reason for security failure in the provided text.
